summary: Macro backdrop for ags: mixed (score +0 across rates, dollar, Brazil real, risk, energy, China, breadth). rates 0; dollar 0; brl +; mxn −; risk 0; energy +; china −; breadth 0. Strongest ag/soft over the month: Class III milk +11.6%; weakest: Corn -14.2%. Key releases ahead: US Federal Funds Rate (10-28 2:00 PM ET); US FOMC Statement (10-28 2:00 PM ET); US FOMC Press Conference (10-28 2:30 PM ET); US Advance GDP q/q (10-29 8:30 AM ET); US Core PCE Price Index m/m (10-29 8:30 AM ET).

sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 5.00% (-11 bp in a month), 2-year 4.69% (-16 bp); 2s10s curve +31 bp (+5 bp in a month). Yields are little changed on the month. T-bill yield 4.03% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 101.69 (+0.7% in a month, +3.5% YTD). USD/BRL 4.996 (-3.7% in a month): a firmer real slows Brazilian farmer selling and supports world prices. USD/CNY 6.661 (-0.8%); USD/MXN 18.69 (+5.4%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -1.1% in a month (+11.4% YTD); VIX 19.4. Neutral risk backdrop.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 101.78 $/bbl (+14.7% in a month), Brent 110.26, ULSD 4.751 $/gal (+8.6%), natural gas 2.99 (-15.4%). Higher crude lifts biofuel margins (soybean oil, corn for ethanol) and synthetic-fibre costs (supports cotton), but raises diesel, drying and freight costs. Natural gas drives nitrogen fertilizer costs for next year's corn.

sections.title: China & industrial demand
sections.text: Copper -4.0% in a month, Shanghai Composite -6.3%, Hang Seng -7.0%, yuan +0.8% vs USD. Soft China/industrial signals point to weaker import demand.

sections.title: Commodity breadth
sections.text: 14 of 33 commodities trade above their 50-day average (42%); S&P GSCI +2.5% in a month; gold -7.4%.

caveat: Directional channels from macro to ag prices are standard relationships, not signals tested on this desk; use as context.
